Independent development brand · Mauritania

Websites, apps and business tools — built around the way you work.

TSX-MR is an independent development brand managed by a Mauritanian developer. It designs and builds websites, mobile applications and management tools for businesses and organisations, in Arabic, French and English.

What TSX-MR can build for you

Three kinds of work, each shaped to the project.

  • Websites

    A clear, fast website that presents your business and makes it easy to reach you.

  • Mobile applications

    An application your customers or your team use on their phones.

  • Business tools

    Software that replaces notebooks and spreadsheets: stock, sales, records and teams.

TSX-MR’s own product

DDukan ERP

Direction

  1. Pick the provider and which way the exchange goes.

  2. The operator types the amount and the commission the customer pays — there is no fixed rate. The operator is whoever is signed in.

  3. The exchange is recorded under the operator’s name, the commission is kept apart and the day’s summary is updated. Dukan ERP does not send or receive money.

How a project runs

Simple steps, agreed with you before any work starts.

  1. 1

    Talk it through

    You describe what you need, and TSX-MR asks the questions that shape it.

  2. 2

    Agree the plan

    The scope, the steps and the timing are written down and agreed before work starts.

  3. 3

    Build and review

    You see the work as it progresses and say what should change.

  4. 4

    Launch

    The result goes live, and any further work is agreed with you.
